import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Price distribution by sensor type
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='sensor_type', y='price_usd', ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Camera Price Distribution by Sensor Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sensor Type', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Megapixels vs Price with brand differentiation
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
top_brands = df['brand'].value_counts().nlargest(5).index
df_top = df[df['brand'].isin(top_brands)]
scatter = ax2.scatter(data=df_top, x='megapixels', y='price_usd', 
                      c=df_top['model_year'], cmap='viridis', 
                      s=df_top['weight_grams']/50, alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_title('Megapixels vs Price (Size=Weight, Color=Year)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Model Year', fontsize=9)

# 3. Body type distribution with 4K video capability
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
body_type_counts = df.groupby(['body_type', 'has_video_4k']).size().unstack()
body_type_counts.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax3, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'])
ax3.set_title('Body Type Distribution with 4K Video Capability', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.legend(['No 4K', 'Has 4K'], title='4K Video')

# 4. Price trends over model years
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
yearly_stats = df.groupby('model_year').agg({'price_usd': ['mean', 'median', 'count']}).reset_index()
yearly_stats.columns = ['model_year', 'mean_price', 'median_price', 'count']
ax4.plot(yearly_stats['model_year'], yearly_stats['mean_price'], marker='o', linewidth=2, label='Mean Price')
ax4.plot(yearly_stats['model_year'], yearly_stats['median_price'], marker='s', linewidth=2, label='Median Price')
ax4.fill_between(yearly_stats['model_year'], yearly_stats['mean_price'], yearly_stats['median_price'], alpha=0.2)
ax4.set_title('Camera Price Trends Over Model Years', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax4.legend()
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Weight distribution by body type
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='body_type', y='weight_grams', ax=ax5, inner='quartile')
ax5.set_title('Weight Distribution by Body Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Correlation heatmap of numerical features
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
numerical_cols = ['model_year', 'megapixels', 'max_iso', 'weight_grams', 'price_usd', 'has_video_4k']
corr_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            center=0, square=True, linewidths=0.5, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout and add main title
plt.suptitle('Digital Camera Market Analysis: Technical Specifications and Pricing', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
